name: qy-core-server
description: 多类前端应用 - 后端服务

scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --schema prisma/auth/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/ws-design/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/approval-workflow/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate:aws: prisma generate --schema prisma/auth/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/approval-workflow/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate: prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/auth/schema.prisma --name init && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/ws-design/schema.prisma --name init && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/approval-workflow/schema.prisma --name init
scripts.prisma:deploy: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/auth/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/ws-design/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/approval-workflow/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:deploy:aws: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/auth/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/approval-workflow/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:seed: npm run prisma:seed:auth && npm run prisma:seed:ws && npm run prisma:seed:approval
